Our Story

How a small group of Ghanaian immigrant Catholics grew into a united community of faith in Chicago.

Our Beginning

Founded on a shared spiritual desire

The Ghanaian Catholic Community was formed out of the passion of a group of Ghanaian immigrants in the Chicago area — Catholics by faith — who shared a spiritual desire to unite all Catholics of Ghanaian descent under one roof, to serve and experience the worship of the Lord in their own native languages and cultural traditions.

What began as a heartfelt hope among a few families became, with prayer and perseverance, a recognized community of the Archdiocese of Chicago — a spiritual home where Ghanaian Catholics could bring their whole selves, language and culture included, before the altar.

Milestones

Our journey so far

February 2017

Community formally inaugurated

The Ghanaian Catholic Community of Chicago was officially inaugurated at St. Malachy + Precious Blood Parish (now Blessed Maria Gabriella), 2248 W. Washington Blvd — the first-ever such inauguration of a Ghanaian community of Catholic worshipers in the Archdiocese of Chicago.

Blessed by Cardinal Cupich

Archdiocesan recognition

The inauguration carried the personal blessing and well-wishes of His Eminence Cardinal Blase Joseph Cupich, Archbishop of Chicago, affirming our place within the wider family of the Archdiocese.

A growing parish family

Rooted at Blessed Maria Gabriella

The community continues to gather weekly at Blessed Maria Gabriella Parish, joined by the Ghanaian Catholic Charismatic Renewal prayer group, growing in worship, service and fellowship.

Today

One family in faith and culture

We remain committed to passing on the Catholic faith and Ghanaian heritage to the next generation, welcoming newcomers to Chicago and anyone who wishes to worship with us.

Our Mission

To unite Catholics of Ghanaian descent in the Chicago area in the worship of God, nurturing our faith through the richness of our native languages, music and traditions, while living out the Gospel in service to one another, to Blessed Maria Gabriella Parish, and to the wider Archdiocese of Chicago.

Be part of our story

Every family who joins us adds a new chapter. Come worship with us this Sunday.
